en.t: Look at you, what on earth are you saying?

units.source_text: 阿光喃喃自语，她忽然像哭过后又高兴的孩子，想淘淘气开开心。

en.t: Aguang murmured to herself; suddenly, like a child who has become happy again after crying, she wanted to play a prank and cheer herself up.

units.source_text: 正巧她的马走过帐篷前，到了距帐篷入口处很近的地方，

en.t: Just then, her horse passed in front of the tent and came very close to the entrance,

units.source_text: 和一匹屁股向着过往行人嚼食干草的无鞍马擦身而过。

en.t: brushing past an unsaddled horse that was chewing hay with its rump turned toward the passersby.

units.source_text: 就在这时，她双膝用力，立即跳到那匹马的背上。

en.t: At that very moment, she pressed hard with both knees and instantly leapt onto that horse's back.
